tools.name: get_f1_season_schedule
tools.description: Get the verified public Formula 1 schedule for a season, including UTC session times, freshness, results, and canonical links.

tools.name: get_f1_standings
tools.description: Get the public Formula 1 driver and constructor standings for a season with canonical source links.

tools.name: get_f1_next_event
tools.description: Find the next Formula 1 session or race weekend from a UTC timestamp, including an event already in progress.

from.description: UTC timestamp to search from. Defaults to the current time.

level.description: Return the next individual session or the next race weekend. Defaults to session.

year.description: Season to search. Defaults to the season containing the search timestamp, then the following season if needed.

inputSchema.description: Select the next Formula 1 session or race weekend from a UTC point in time.

tools.name: get_f1_session_results
tools.description: Get the published F1DB classification for one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key, with positions and available result details.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

inputSchema.description: Select one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key.

tools.name: get_f1_starting_grid
tools.description: Get the published F1DB starting grid for one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key; use session results for the final classification.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

inputSchema.description: Select one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key.

tools.name: get_f1_race_weekend
tools.description: Get one public Formula 1 race weekend by season and exactly one friendly selector: meeting key, round, race name, or slug.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

raceName.description: Human-friendly Grand Prix or race name, matched case-insensitively.

round.description: Championship round number for the season.

slug.description: Race Calendar race slug, such as round-6-miami-grand-prix or miami-grand-prix.

inputSchema.description: Select one race weekend by season and exactly one of meetingKey, round, raceName, or slug.

tools.name: get_f1_race_classification
tools.description: Get a published F1DB race, qualifying, or sprint classification by season and a friendly race selector, without requiring meeting or session keys.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

raceName.description: Human-friendly Grand Prix or race name, matched case-insensitively.

round.description: Championship round number for the season.

slug.description: Race Calendar race slug, such as round-6-miami-grand-prix or miami-grand-prix.

classification.description: Published F1DB classification to return. Defaults to the Grand Prix race.

inputSchema.description: Select one race weekend and its race, qualifying, or sprint classification using a friendly selector.

tools.name: get_f1_circuit
tools.description: Get circuit metadata and normalized track geometry for a race weekend selected by meeting key, round, race name, or slug.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

raceName.description: Human-friendly Grand Prix or race name, matched case-insensitively.

round.description: Championship round number for the season.

slug.description: Race Calendar race slug, such as round-6-miami-grand-prix or miami-grand-prix.

inputSchema.description: Select one race weekend by season and exactly one of meetingKey, round, raceName, or slug.

tools.name: get_f1_race_preview
tools.description: Get a structurally spoiler-safe race-weekend briefing containing schedule and venue context but no classifications, winners, podiums, or result fields.

meetingKey.description: OpenF1 meeting key for the race weekend.

raceName.description: Human-friendly Grand Prix or race name, matched case-insensitively.

round.description: Championship round number for the season.

slug.description: Race Calendar race slug, such as round-6-miami-grand-prix or miami-grand-prix.

inputSchema.description: Select one race weekend by season and exactly one of meetingKey, round, raceName, or slug.

tools.name: get_f1_live_session
tools.description: Get the latest explicitly timestamped status for the current or selected Formula 1 session. Returns unavailable rather than implying stale data is live.

meetingKey.description: Optional OpenF1 meeting key. Omit to discover the current live session.

sessionKey.description: Optional OpenF1 session key. Requires meetingKey when supplied.

year.description: Season to inspect. Defaults to the current UTC season.

inputSchema.description: Inspect the current Formula 1 session or select one by season, meeting key, and session key.

tools.name: get_f1_historical_race_result
tools.description: Get one complete historical Formula 1 race classification by season and championship round. Use only for a single race; for two or more races, call get_f1_historical_race_results once instead.

round.description: Championship round number in the historical season.

inputSchema.description: Select a historical Formula 1 race by season and championship round.

tools.name: get_f1_historical_race_results
tools.description: Get 2 to 8 complete historical Formula 1 race classifications in one consolidated request, with per-race sources and bounded partial failures. Use once for multi-race questions instead of repeating get_f1_historical_race_result.

round.description: Championship round number in the historical season.

items.description: Select a historical Formula 1 race by season and championship round.

races.description: Two to eight historical races to retrieve in one request.

inputSchema.description: Select 2 to 8 historical Formula 1 races for one consolidated multi-race lookup.

tools.name: search_f1_history
tools.description: Search the Formula 1 history index for drivers, teams, circuits, and races with bounded, cursor-based results.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by an earlier history search.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10 and never exceeds 20.

query.description: Driver, team, circuit, or race text to find.

types.description: Optional unique entity types to include in the search.

inputSchema.description: Search the bounded Formula 1 history index.

tools.name: get_f1_updates
tools.description: Get recent public schedule, standings, and result changes after an optional timestamp or cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by an earlier updates request.

limit.description: Maximum changes to return. Defaults to 20 and never exceeds 50.

since.description: Only return changes after this UTC timestamp.

inputSchema.description: Read a bounded page of recent public Formula 1 changes.

tools.name: compare_f1_competitors
tools.description: Compare two Formula 1 drivers or constructors in one season using sourced standings and explicitly described calculations.

competitorType.description: Compare two drivers or two constructors.

left.description: First driver or constructor name to compare.

right.description: Second driver or constructor name to compare.

inputSchema.description: Compare two drivers or two constructors within one Formula 1 season.
